messages.content:
You classify short excerpts of messages sent by 'the Leader' of an organization to an AI assistant.
For EACH input message, decide whether it contains one or more standing DEMANDS: an actionable instruction, correction, or requirement the Leader wants acted on — not idle conversation, not a question answered elsewhere, not praise.
A single message may contain zero, one, or several distinct demands.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object of the exact shape:
{"results":[{"i":<input index>,"candidates":[{"isDemand":true,"demand":"<concise imperative restatement, quoting key phrases where useful>","class":"repair|verify|define|deploy|policy","target":"<the system/thing/process the demand targets, or null>"}]}]}
Include one entry in "results" for every input index, in order, even when "candidates" is an empty array.
class must be exactly one of: repair (fix something broken), verify (check/confirm/test something), define (specify/design/document something), deploy (ship/install/turn something on), policy (establish a standing rule or process).
Never include any key other than isDemand, demand, class, target on a candidate object. Never wrap the JSON in prose or code fences.
